message.Title: Public Preview: AKS Automatic managed system node pools

Body.Content:
Provisioning and maintaining system node pools in AKS requires ongoing effort to ensure proper scaling, patching, and availability, tasks that can divert resources from application development and delivery.

Managed system node pools in AKS Automatic removes this operational burden by providing a fully managed infrastructure layer that handles system components without customer intervention. This means teams no longer need to maintain infrastructure for system workloads, allowing them to focus entirely on deploying and scaling applications. By isolating system workloads from customer applications, AKS Automatic improves reliability and ensures consistent performance backed by SLAs. The result is faster time to value, reduced infrastructure overhead, and a simplified path to Kubernetes adoption.
Learn more.
